title: Hello! Getting started on a project with some friends and will DEFINITELY have questions.

posts.author: Quinn-ShaggyTurtleStudios
posts.body:
I've been using various versions of RPGMaker since I was a young teen messing around with SNES emulation.
Never finished any of my projects though. I'm sure I'm not the only one with a similar story. lol
Recently however, Me and a couple of close friends got copies of RPGMaker MV (I've actually had a copy for a few years. but I bought a copy for one friend and the other bought himself a copy.)  set out to actually bring a story I've wanted to tell since I was a kid to life. (Don't worry. It's changed A LOT since I was 7. lmao)
I have a few questions regarding states and events that I could use answers for if someone would be willing to direct me to the appropriate places to ask! of pressing note is a couple of custom status effects that tie into the story and theme of the game.
Hopefully we'll be seeing each other around for a bit! Making a game is definitely a time consuming process.
